source_text: Deltamethrin resistance in An. gambiae (s.l.) was only recorded in one of the eight study sites (Burangi: n = 100, mortality 45.5%).
Coincidentally, permethrin resistance was also reported in the same study site (n = 100, mortality 48%).
Adult mosquitoes were resistant to fenitrothion in Jaribuni (n = 100, mortality 88%)
However, the possibility of resistance that requires further investigation was recorded against bendiocarb in Mbogolo (n = 75, mortality 93%)
